verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships an official MCP server (docs.semgrep.dev/mcp) letting coding agents call the scanner directly, plus first-party messaging on scanning/fixing AI-generated code the moment it's written and combining AI reasoning with rule-based detection, and a pre-commit hook to catch issues before they land in Git history. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that the MCP integration reliably works inside real agent workflows, and detail on latency or false-positive behavior when used inline with AI code generation.
